text: The Mediterranean Sea lies between North Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The Phoenicians were maritime traders who were famous for their ships and a special shade of purple called Tyrian purple. The Phoenicians were a trading empire that lasted from about 2500 BC to 64 BC and traded mostly on the Mediterranean Sea. However, at the height of their power, they also traded along the coast of Africa and even India.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarises this entire paragraph?
b: The Phoenicians were an empire that spread far and quickly with the help of horses.
++The Phoenicians were a trading empire in the Mediterranean who were famous for their ships and Tyrian purple dye.
The Phoenicians would also trade along the coast of Africa and even India.

atoms.text: The Phoenicians were famous for their ships and because no other empire was as skilful at maritime trade as they were. They had long wooden boats with the head of a horse carved into the front of the ship which were built to move through water quickly. Their ships were also wide so that they were able to bring a lot of cargo for trading. The most popular goods that the Phoenicians traded were textiles and Tyrian purple dye.

b: ++Phoenician ships were built to move quickly and transport a lot of cargo.
The Phoenicians were a trading empire in the Mediterranean who were famous for their ships and Tyrian purple dye.
They had long wooden boats with the head of a cow carved into the front of the ship.

atoms.text: Tyrian purple is a very special colour that is made from the shells of the murex snail. At the time, this colour was so rare and beloved that it became so expensive that only royalty or very powerful people were able to purchase it. Tyrian purple was a symbol of status and has become known as royal purple. The Phoenicians were so famous for trading dye from murex snails that they put a murex snail on their coins.

b: ++Tyrian purple was a very rare colour that became a symbol of power and royalty.
The Phonecians were so famous for trading dye from murex snails that they put a murex snail on their coins.
Tyrian purple is a very special colour that is naturally made from the shells of the murex snail.
